title: Parallel researcher and critic joined by a composer

turns.question: What does the warranty cover for a broken zipper on my winter jacket?
And what if I bought the jacket second-hand from another customer?
How do I send the jacket in for the repair, and who pays for the shipping?
Thanks, that answers everything I wanted to know about the repair.

reply.content: The customer asked about warranty cover for a broken zipper and about second-hand purchases.
Research: zippers are covered for 24 months when the defect is not caused by misuse.
Research: the warranty follows the jacket, so second-hand owners need the original receipt.
Research: repairs are booked online and the prepaid label is free inside the EU.
Critique: the answer should mention that proof of purchase is required for every warranty claim.
Critique: explain what happens when the first owner cannot share the receipt.
Critique: say that shipping outside the EU is paid by the customer.
Critique: a short closing is enough here.
Your jacket warranty covers a broken zipper for 24 months, as long as it was not misused. Please keep your proof of purchase, because every claim needs it.
The warranty stays with the jacket, so you can claim it second-hand, but you need the original receipt from the first owner; without it we can only offer a paid repair.
Book the repair online and print the prepaid label; shipping is free inside the EU, and customers outside the EU pay for the shipping themselves.
You are welcome. Good luck with the repair!
